name: Feature Extraction Network
definition: Network architecture for extracting features from input images, based on ResNet34 with specific convolutional and up-convolutional layers for feature fusion.
summary: The Feature Extraction Network maps 2D images to multi-scale features for neural radiance fields using a ResNet34 backbone with up-convolutional fusion, distinct from sibling methods by its deeper residual structure and explicit multi-scale concatenation.
